termsBody:
NOOR provides personalized AI portraits to adults aged 18 and over. The seller is identified below. By ordering, you confirm that you have the rights and consent needed to upload and process the photos, including permission from any adult depicted. Impersonating another person or a celebrity, misleading identity use, unlawful content and infringement of third-party rights are prohibited.

Packages are €7 for 3 portraits, €19 for 5, €29 for 10 and €49 for 20. The selected package and total are shown before payment. This is a one-time purchase, with no subscription. AI results may vary in facial resemblance and detail; one revision request is included, subject to photo availability during the retention period.

Delivery is digital only through a private order/download link. No physical goods are shipped. Portraits are usually ready within a few minutes and will be delivered no later than 24 hours after successful payment. If generation fails or nothing is delivered within 24 hours, you are entitled to a full refund. Download your files before the retention period ends.

Prices are in EUR. Payments are processed by a Georgian acquirer, and the card issuer may apply a conversion or fees shown on your statement. The Payment and Refund policies form part of these terms.

These terms are governed by the laws of Georgia, without limiting any mandatory consumer rights that apply to you. For support, complaints or requests to remove content, email {email} with your order reference and a description of the issue. Do not send card details.
privacyBody:
The seller identified below is responsible for the personal data used to provide NOOR services. We process your email, uploaded photos, portrait preferences, generated images, order and payment references, and consent records to fulfill orders, provide support, prevent abuse and meet legal obligations. We do not receive or store payment card numbers, expiry dates or card security codes.

Photos are stored in private storage. Access requires an authorized session or a temporary signed link. Image metadata is removed during processing. {aiProcessing} Hosting and storage are provided by Vercel and Cloudflare; order emails are handled by Resend. Providers may process data outside your country. We do not use your photos for advertising or model training without separate permission.

The current photo retention periods are shown below. Access to expired files is blocked immediately; the hourly cleanup deletes them from active storage. You can use the photo-deletion control in your private order to delete its reference photos and results from active storage, or email {email} for assistance. Deletion may prevent further delivery or revisions. This does not automatically delete order, payment, consent or audit records, which have no automatic deletion schedule in the application. Contact us to request access, correction or deletion; records needed for legal obligations or disputes may be retained. We cannot promise that deleting active files immediately erases provider logs or backups.

Necessary cookies protect order and administrator access. An order draft is stored in your browser's session storage. Optional audience measurement uses a one-day session cookie; pseudonymous visit and step records are removed after 30 days by scheduled cleanup. You can decline or withdraw consent in Measurement preferences. For privacy concerns or removal requests, email {email}.
refundBody:
You are entitled to a full refund if portrait generation fails or no portraits are delivered within 24 hours after successful payment. You do not have to accept a revision or wait for manual fulfillment instead of a refund in those cases.

Email {email} within 14 days of payment, quoting your order reference, the email used for the order and the reason for your request. For poor resemblance, visible defects or an incorrect style, one revision request is included while the photos remain available; you may also contact us to request a refund review. A revision does not remove your rights where the service is defective or not delivered.

Refunds are returned only to the original payment card, within 5–10 business days after approval. The card issuer determines when the credit appears and may apply its own exchange rate. Never send your full card number or security code by email.

The request period does not restrict any longer period or other remedy required by applicable consumer law. Digital delivery does not automatically exclude all refund rights.

payment-policyBody:
Prices and checkout totals are in EUR: €7 for 3 portraits, €19 for 5, €29 for 10, or €49 for 20. Payment is a one-time charge for digital portraits; there is no physical delivery or recurring subscription.

Card payments are processed through Bank of Georgia (BOG) or Flitt (TBC Bank) in Georgia. You enter payment details on the acquirer's hosted checkout. Available card and wallet options, including Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay and Google Pay, depend on the acquirer, your card and device, and are displayed on that page.

The payment amount and currency are shown before confirmation. Your card issuer may convert the amount into the currency of your account and apply fees, so your statement may show a converted amount. NOOR does not set your bank's exchange rate.

Work begins after payment is verified. Digital delivery is usually within minutes and no later than 24 hours after payment. Generation failure or no delivery within 24 hours entitles you to a full refund under the Refund policy. For payment questions or duplicate charges, email {email} with your order reference. Never send card details.
security-policyBody:
Card details are entered on the payment page hosted by the selected acquirer, Bank of Georgia or Flitt, which handles card processing under PCI DSS security requirements. NOOR does not host a card-entry form and does not receive or store card numbers, expiry dates or CVV/CVC codes.

The acquirer uses 3-D Secure for supported transactions when required by the card issuer. Authentication may be completed without an additional prompt; your bank may instead request approval in its app or a one-time code. Never share that code with NOOR or anyone else.

Connections use HTTPS. NOOR keeps order identifiers, amounts, currencies, payment statuses and acquirer transaction references to reconcile payments and handle refunds. Payment confirmation is checked against the acquirer's response. To report a suspected payment-security issue, email {email} without including card details or passwords.
compliance-policyBody:
NOOR is operated by the individual entrepreneur identified below, in Georgia, and provides digital AI portrait services. Georgian law governs the service, subject to mandatory consumer and privacy rights applicable to the customer. This policy does not imply approval or endorsement by a bank, card network or public authority.

The service is for adults aged 18 and over. You must own or have permission to use the uploaded photographs and obtain the consent of every person depicted. Impersonating another person or a celebrity, identity fraud, unlawful sexual content, exploitation, harassment and infringement of copyright, privacy or personality rights are prohibited.

We may refuse or remove content that violates these rules or applicable law. If an order cannot be fulfilled, contact us under the Refund policy. We respond to valid legal requests and retain relevant records where legally required.

To report misuse, submit a complaint or request removal of an image, email {email}. Include the order reference or relevant link, a description of your concern and evidence of your rights where appropriate. Do not include payment card data. We may ask for proportionate information to verify the request.
